items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: Faith was, um, had an idea, he was, he was going to change banjo and he was using, uh, the Willie Forrestone banjo... So, I, I went out to the rehearsal and, and I must have did good because, uh, next thing I think the next week or so they had me in the banjo

ctx.x: Because you go out the highway, it was closer to the river.

Yeah, closer to the river, that's right. Yeah, I believe it was the Beverly Garden. Well, anyhow, when, after they let us off, well, that particular time, I used to do this, you'd get a place to call the entertainment club. Well, all the musicians used to hang around there and we used to go down there and, like if we had a job, we'd go sit in with the band and, you know, jam session. And, um, Faith Marvel band, all the band used to hang around there when they'd get off in their wake, you know, and, well, I had to…
Okay, we're back to Willie Foster now.
